title: Prepress Operator
description:
LearnTastic is looking for an experienced Prepress Operator to join our production workflow remotely.
You will work closely with our account managers and in-house prepress team to keep moving efficiently, maintain print quality, and meet production deadlines.
This is a hands-on production role for someone with commercial printing experience who understands print specifications, colour management, imposition, and prepress workflows. We will train you on our specific templates, equipment, and processes, but you should already be confident in managing prepress independently.
Key Responsibilities:

• Review incoming files against tickets, checking trim size, bleed, margins, image resolution, fonts, colour specifications, page count, page order, overprint, trapping, rich black, and missing assets.

• Use Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat Pro, and Enfocus PitStop to resolve prepress issues.

• Coordinate with account managers when corrections require input.

• Manage PDF proofs, generate and send proofs for approval, implement requested changes, and issue revised proofs until approval is received.

• Prepare press-ready layouts based on press specifications and paper sizes, including step-and-repeat, work-and-turn, sheetwise, booklet signatures, creep adjustments, registration marks, and colour bars.

• Create new layouts when an existing template does not accommodate dimensions or specifications.

• Process approved files through Kodak Prinergy and, where required, Fujifilm XMF, ensuring files are ready for the in-house team.

• Manage production priorities in coordination with account managers, balancing deadlines, approvals, and production requirements.

• Communicate proactively, keep account managers informed of file issues, pending approvals, and potential delays, using email, chat, and phone as needed.

What You'll Need to Succeed:

• At least 3 years of hands-on prepress experience with a commercial offset printing company, either sheetfed or web.

• Proven experience imposing print, and preparing files for production.

• Daily, practical experience with professional prepress workflows and imposition software. Kodak Prinergy and Preps are preferred; experience with Fujifilm XMF, Screen Trueflow, Heidelberg Prinect, or Agfa Apogee is also relevant.

• Strong working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat Pro on a Mac.

• Experience with Enfocus PitStop for preflight, PDF inspection, and file correction.

• A solid understanding of commercial print production, including colour separations, CMYK and spot colours, Pantone specifications, overprint, trapping, bleeds, and print marks.

• Good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally

• Strong attention to detail, sound production judgment, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently.

• Reliable internet with speeds of at least 25 Mbps, a backup internet connection, backup power, and a quiet, suitable workspace.

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7-10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.
About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017 by landscape ecologist and fire mitigation expert Harry Statter, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.
Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As a Senior FP&A Analyst at Frontline, you will own the financial models, the 13-week cash flow, and the consolidated reporting that gives leadership a real picture of where the business stands and where it's headed. Reporting to the VP of Finance, you will build and maintain the models, own the cash flow forecast, and synthesize data across multiple systems into the KPIs and analysis that drive decisions. We use AI tools to accelerate the development of financial models and analysis. That kind of critical thinking, grounded in deep financial knowledge, is what separates meaningful analysis from a fast first draft.

• Design models that are structurally sound, well-documented, and built to be used and understood by others - not black boxes.

Cash Flow Forecasting

• Own the 13-week cash flow forecast for a multi-entity company - building it, maintaining it, and communicating what it shows and why it matters.

title: Product Development Manager
description:
Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business, offering eco-friendly Home & Kitchen products , is seeking a Product Development Manager to lead their efforts in developing new products and improving existing ones.
This role involves close collaboration with Brand Managers and Sourcing Agents to ensure the products meet the evolving needs of the customers and maintain competitive advantage.
About the company:
It is a fast-growing brand developing several new green and sustainable products for eco-conscious consumers . Currently, the company sells mostly on Amazon, but it also operates on Shopify and Walmart. It has over 200,000 customers in 7 countries (USA, Canada, Mexico, UK, Germany, Japan, China). The company just partnered up with a sales team in the US who will work on getting its products in physical retail stores.
This work is changing the world here because his e-commerce brand is set to positively impact the lives of thousands of eco-conscious people who choose to use the companys eco-friendly products, saving tons of plastic waste and CO2 every year. The company is also committed to environmental and social causes, having planted 10,000 trees and financing plastic waste collection from the oceans through our partners at Clean Hub.
Key Responsibilities:

• Lead cross-functional teams to develop new products and enhance existing product lines.

• Manage the entire product development lifecycle from concept through design, prototyping, testing, and market introduction.

• Analyze market trends and customer feedback to identify opportunities for new products and product improvements.

• Work closely with sourcing agents to identify and evaluate suppliers, ensuring product quality and cost-effectiveness.

• Coordinate with Brand Managers to align product development with brand strategy and market positioning.

• Prepare detailed product development plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource requirements.

• Monitor and report on product development progress, including challenges and milestones.

• Monitor product performance, identify risks, issues, and problems, escalate as appropriate, proposing mitigation plans to overcome obstacles.

• Drive a focus on design and cost to ensure the delivery of excellent products to our consumers at valued price points.

• Be responsible for product documentation including specifications, manuals, packaging, case studies, product comparisons, competitor analysis, and user stories. Be an expert with respect to the competition.

• Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and quality standards.

Qualifications:

• Minimum of 2 years experience in product development in an e-commerce company selling on Amazon

• Strong project management skills with a proven ability to lead cross-functional teams.

• Excellent analytical skills and the ability to think critically.

• Engineering background or strong understanding of manufacturing and sourcing processes.

• Creativity and innovation for improving product design and functionality.

• Ability to work independently.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams.

• Experience working with international markets and suppliers from China is highly desirable.

• Advanced English.

What We Offer:

• Fully remote and full-time role.

• Paid time off.

• Quarterly bonuses.

• Professional growth opportunities, such as managing staff members and growing your skill set.

• Competitive and timely salary.

• Opportunity to work remotely in an international company.

• Dynamic, creative work environments.

• Flexible schedule.

title: Vendor Management Contracts Associate
description:
The Vendor Management Contracts Associate supports the end-to-end administration of vendor contracts and supplier records, ensuring contracts are accurately maintained, tracked, and managed in accordance with company policies and governance requirements. Working closely with Vendor Managers, Vendor Owners, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Operational stakeholders, the role provides contract lifecycle support, maintains contract documentation, and assists with renewal, compliance, and reporting activities. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage deadlines independently are essential.
​​Role and Responsibilities​
Contract Administration & Lifecycle Support

• Support Vendor Managers and business stakeholders in the preparation, review, and administration of vendor agreements, statements of work (SOWs), amendments, renewals, and termination documentation.

• Draft vendor contracts and contract amendments using approved templates and stakeholder-provided information.

• Coordinate contract approval and execution processes, ensuring all required reviews and approvals are completed.

• Monitor contract expiry dates, renewal windows, and notice periods, proactively highlighting upcoming actions to Vendor Managers and stakeholders.

• Assist in tracking contract obligations, key milestones, and deliverables throughout the contract lifecycle.

Vendor Documentation & Governance

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date vendor records, contracts, agreements, and supporting documentation within company systems and repositories.

• Ensure all executed agreements and associated documents are filed and maintained in accordance with document management standards, naming conventions, and governance requirements.

• Support quality assurance reviews of vendor documentation to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with company policies.

• Assist with audit requests, compliance reviews, and documentation retrieval activities.

Stakeholder Coordination

• Act as a point of contact for routine vendor contract administration queries and follow-up activities.

• Coordinate communications between Vendor Managers, Vendor Owners, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and operational stakeholders as required.

• Escalate contract, compliance, or vendor-related issues to the appropriate stakeholders for review and resolution.

• Provide regular updates to the Vendor Management team regarding contract status, upcoming renewals, and outstanding actions.

Financial & Reporting Support

• Coordinate with Finance regarding purchase orders, invoices, budget tracking, and vendor payment queries.

• Support the maintenance of vendor spend, contract, and renewal reporting information.

• Prepare regular reports, dashboards, and management information relating to vendor contracts, renewals, compliance activities, and vendor data.

• Assist in the collection of information required for budget planning and vendor forecasting activities.

Process Improvement

• Support continuous improvement initiatives relating to vendor management processes, contract administration, record management, and reporting.

• Assist in maintaining contract templates, process documentation, guidance materials, and standard operating procedures.

• Identify opportunities to improve data quality, contract tracking, and administrative efficiency.

Specified Additional Responsibilities
Support and back up other team members with vendor management and onboarding activities as per the vendor management processes.
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Supply Chain, or related field. Basic knowledge in Legal area is a plus.
- Experience in contract administration, vendor management, procurement support, commercial operations, legal administration, or a related discipline.
- Understanding of contract lifecycle management principles and document control processes.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

title: Software Engineer, AI Data - Phoenix, AZ, USA
description:
Mission
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify 's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.
We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

• Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.

• Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

• Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.

• Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

• A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.

• Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.

• Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.

• Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

• Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

• Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

• A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

• A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

• Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

• The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

• Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

• The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

• An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio - a rapidly evolving tech domain

title: CNC Operator
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a CNC Operator to execute high-precision machining operations and drive manufacturing excellence on our production floor in Morrisville,NC. This role will be on the Production team and partner across the engineering organization, quality organization, and assembly teams to build next-generation hardware.

This role will be dynamic and full of new engagement, challenges, and opportunities to bring the core elements of success for an aerospace machining program-complex machine setups, tight-tolerance machining of advanced materials, rigorous tool control and FOD prevention, in-process inspection, and machine maintenance. The role will also support the development and adoption of new advanced manufacturing processes. As Anduril grows, our machining capabilities and the scope of this role will grow too. If you are someone who has passion for the quality of their work, is hands-on with advanced CNC equipment, and wants to be accountable for hardware that matters, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Operating of CNC mills, lathes, multi-axis routers

• Interpreting CAD design models.

title: Team Lead Business Development (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

As a Team Lead Business Development (m/f/d) , you will be managing operational and regulatory processes such as permits, bus stop authorizations, and service documentation, along with contributing to market launches and expansion initiatives across the Black Sea region (Romania, Bulgaria and Greece).
You will be driving partner acquisition and managing the full sales lifecycle - from first contact through contract signing - while ensuring alignment with internal processes and timelines. You will oversee and support a team of BD professionals in Bucharest and Sofia, track performance, remove blockers, and coordinate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution.

About the Role

• Identify and initiate contact with new bus partners, while supporting the development of long-term strategic relationships

• Coordinate and monitor the full sales cycle (from partner acquisition to contract signing), ensuring compliance with internal procedures, timelines, and quality standards

• Lead the day-to-day management of BD managers/specialists, including priority setting, KPI tracking, performance oversight, and removal of operational blockers

• Oversee the preparation, processing, and verification of documentation required for county, inter-county, and international transport permits

• Manage operational planning activities, including preparation of timetables, price lists, itineraries, and driver schedules, ensuring submission for approval and signature

• Coordinate and monitor bus stop authorization processes across national and international networks, working closely with regulatory bodies and bus stations

• Support market expansion and new country launches, while acting as the key interface between BD and internal teams (Network Planning, Operations, Legal, Finance) to ensure smooth information and documentation flow

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Transport & Logistics, or a related field

• 5+ years of experience in business development, partner management, or operations, ideally within transportation, logistics or mobility

• Previous experience in a team lead or supervisory role is mandatory

• Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools; fluency in Romanian and professional English is a must

• Solid understanding of road transport regulations and licensing procedures; experience working with regulatory bodies is a plus

• Experience in preparing operational transport documentation; CPC certification (per EC Regulation 1071/2009) is a strong advantage

• Strong communication, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, tasks, and KPIs.

• Highly organized, proactive, team-oriented, and comfortable working on international projects

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

NB: Please submit your resume in English!

What We Offer

• Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 

• Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 

• Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 

• Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 

• Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 

• Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
Blanc Labs is a premier partner for global enterprises, leading the way in digitization, automation, and the development of next-generation digital products and services. Our expertise in digital transformation powers businesses to accelerate service delivery, drive customer engagement, and foster growth.
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Hands-on Software Architect to lead the design and evolution of modern cloud-native applications while remaining actively involved in software development. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, mentoring engineering teams, and driving architectural decisions without stepping away from coding, supporting the modernization of existing monolithic applications into distributed microservices while collaborating closely with product managers, engineering teams, and stakeholders to ensure technical solutions align with business objectives.
What You’ll be Doing:

• Design and evolve scalable software architectures for enterprise applications

• Lead the modernization of legacy monolithic systems into cloud-native microservices using patterns such as Strangler Fig, Change Data Capture (CDC), and event-driven architectures

• Develop production-ready software using Java (Spring Boot), Laravel (PHP), and React

• Design RESTful APIs and asynchronous integrations using Kafka and Amazon SQS

• Define service boundaries, data ownership, and communication strategies across distributed systems

• Architect and implement cloud solutions on AWS, ensuring scalability, resiliency, and cost efficiency

• Participate actively in coding, design reviews, and technical implementation

• Perform code reviews and promote engineering best practices across development teams

• Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive long-term improvements

• Collaborate with DevOps teams on deployment strategies, monitoring, and operational excellence

• Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership throughout the software development lifecycle

• Drive continuous improvements in architecture, development processes, and system observability

What You’ll Need to Be Successful:

• 8+ years of experience designing and developing enterprise software solutions

• Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot

• Professional experience developing applications with Laravel (PHP) and React

• Deep understanding of object-oriented design principles and software engineering best practices

• Extensive experience designing distributed systems and cloud-native applications

• Strong understanding of architectural patterns, including Microservices, Modular Monoliths, Strangler Fig, CDC, Event-Driven Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and RESTful APIs

• Experience implementing asynchronous communication using Kafka and/or Amazon SQS

• Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including MySQL, Amazon RDS, and Amazon DynamoDB

• Experience with Debezium or other CDC technologies

• Solid understanding of software design patterns (GoF) and architectural best practices

• Experience with AWS services, including ECS, EC2, DynamoDB, SQS, RDS, VPC, IAM, and Systems Manager Parameter Store

• Experience troubleshooting complex production environments

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience modernizing large-scale monolithic applications

• Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes)

• Knowledge of observability tools such as New Relic, CloudWatch, Grafana, or Prometheus

• Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation)

• Familiarity with Redis or distributed caching solutions

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) - New Bedford, MA
description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Full administrative support.

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

title: Contrôleur
description:
À propos de Harris
Harris est une entreprise spécialisée dans les solutions logicielles destinées à divers secteurs, offrant des produits et services qui soutiennent les opérations essentielles de ses clients. Elle se distingue par son engagement à fournir des solutions durables, un service à la clientèle de qualité et une approche axée sur des relations à long terme, tout en favorisant l’innovation et l’excellence opérationnelle.

Contrôleur - Le rôle
En tant que contrôleur de gestion, ce professionnel sera chargé de fournir un soutien et des analyses financières qui auront une incidence directe sur la réussite de l'entreprise. Il dirigera une équipe de professionnels de la finance et supervisera les processus de clôture mensuelle, trimestrielle et annuelle, tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de direction opérationnelle en tant que conseiller de confiance.
Responsabilités et missions :

• Veiller à l'exactitude, à l'exhaustivité et à la remise dans les délais des rapports financiers mensuels

• Vérifier les rapprochements comptables, examiner les résultats mensuels et préparer les rapports destinés à la direction

• Réaliser des analyses comptables techniques conformément aux Normes internationales d'information financière (IFRS)

• Diriger, encadrer et accompagner une équipe de professionnels de la finance

• Contribuer à l'intégration des nouvelles acquisitions au sein du service financier

• Participer à l'élaboration des prévisions de chiffre d'affaires net et de charges d'exploitation

Exigences :

• Formation en comptabilité, en finance ou dans un domaine connexe;

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en comptabilité ou en finance, ou expérience équivalente;

• Titre de CPA;

• Excellent esprit d'analyse;

• Compétences avérées en matière de leadership;

• Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles et de communication;

• Une bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais est requise car le titulaire du poste aura à communiquer fréquemment dans les deux langues, tant oralement que par écrit. Nous avons des collègues, des clients et des partenaires au Québec, ainsi que dans le reste du Canada et aux États-Unis.

Ce que nous vous offrons :

• Une culture d’entreprise axée sur l’autonomie, l’innovation et la collaboration

• Des avantages sociaux complets (assurances collectives 100% payé par l’employeur, REER avec contribution de l’employeur, etc.)

• Un horaire flexible

• 100 % télétravail

• Des opportunités concrètes de développement professionnel

*Seuls les candidats retenus seront contactés*.
Harris s'engage en faveur d'un programme d'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi, et les candidatures des membres de groupes ciblés, y compris les femmes, les personnes handicapées, les peuples autochtones et les minorités visibles, sont encouragées. Si vous êtes une personne en situation de handicap, vous pouvez recevoir de l'aide pour le processus de sélection et de sélection sur demande.
L'équipe d'acquisition de talents de Harris n'utilise pas de messages texte pour communiquer avec les candidats ou solliciter des informations confidentielles. Nous encourageons tous les candidats à postuler aux postes affichés. Ils seront contactés soit par un gestionnaire de Harris, soit par un membre de l'équipe d'acquisition de talents pour une entrevue, à condition qu'ils répondent aux critères requis.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior OCI Consultant to architect, deploy, and operate large-scale, secure, and resilient cloud environments on Oracle’s next-generation public cloud. In this role you will own the full OCI engineering lifecycle, from landing-zone design and infrastructure-as-code, through workload migration and ongoing operations, including cost optimization and observability. • Build and maintain OCI infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and OCI Resource Manager, with version control, peer review, and automated validation.

• Implement IAM policies, federation with corporate identity providers, and strong RBAC patterns using OCI Identity Domains.

• Design and operate OCI compute (VMs, bare-metal, OKE for Kubernetes) and storage services (Object, Block, File, Archive) optimized for workload patterns.

• Operate OCI database services, including Autonomous Database, Exadata Cloud, MySQL HeatWave, and Base Database, in close partnership with DBA teams.

• Build CI/CD pipelines on OCI DevOps service or external platforms (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) for both infrastructure and applications.

• Implement observability using OCI Monitoring, Logging, APM, and integrations with third-party observability stacks.

• Drive ongoing cost optimization through right-sizing, lifecycle management, and architectural simplification.

• Design disaster-recovery and business-continuity solutions across OCI regions and availability domains.

• Strengthen security posture using OCI Cloud Guard, Security Zones, Vault, and Data Safe, and lead remediation of findings.

• Advise application development teams on OCI-native design patterns and best practices.

• Develop automation tooling in Python, Bash, and Terraform to reduce operational toil.

• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal cloud communities of practice.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with strong hands-on time on OCI.

• Production-level experience with infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

• Solid experience with OCI compute, networking, storage, identity, and database services.

• Hands-on experience with Oracle Container Engine for Kubernetes (OKE).

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for cloud workloads.

title: Support Engineer (DevTools & AI Reliability, remote)
description:
(Remote, US East Coast or the same time zone. Series B. DevTools SaaS. Synthetic monitoring. 40h/week)

The best developers don’t wait for a customer to tell them something’s broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly’s whole reason to exist. Now that agents write and ship more and more code, they can carry that instinct too. Agents write, run, and maintain the monitoring setup that guards production, while developers stay in control. Everything is defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, and versioned and reviewed like everything else that ships. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

AI agents are shipping more code than any team can review, and reliability is lagging behind. Checkly closes this gap. As a Support Engineer, you’ll support our most valuable customers, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password on that journey.

In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B https://www.checklyhq.com/blog/announcing-20m-to-enable-engineers-to-detect-and-r/ funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel. We’re a remote-first startup that is low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love actually listening to and working with customers, working async, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

We care about building a team where people of all backgrounds are encouraged to do their best work. To achieve this we built a flexible and async-first https://blog.checklyhq.com/how-to-build-a-leading-remote-first-company-while-exceeding-company-goals-do-this/ startup environment with inclusive benefits https://www.notion.so/ad474bec3a5d4d17bfbb43ebae3fec9c?pvs=4 and full transparency about how we pay.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Support has always been about solving real problems for real people. What’s changing at Checkly is how we do it: AI lets us automate routine work and assist us with troubleshooting, so we can go deeper on hard cases and bring what customers tell us straight back to the product. Here’s where you come in:

- Resolve customer issues. Debug Playwright tests (flaky selectors, timeouts, auth flows). Dig into API check failures with packet captures (PCAPs), traceroutes and timing breakdowns. Set up single sign-on (SSO) and SAML. When it’s a bug, bring engineering a clean reproduction, or open the pull request (PR) yourself.

- Build an outstanding AI support process. Our internal and external support agents already resolve 80% of tickets. You’ll help lift the bar: what the agent answers, when it hands off to a human, and how good those answers are.

- Turn tickets into product. Spot patterns across customers and bring product and engineering a reproduction. Your work becomes bug fixes and features.

- Own the docs. If you’ve answered something twice, it belongs in the docs and in the agent, so customers and AI get the same right answer.

- Work with modern tooling. We are continuously updating our workbench, and you’ll have modern tools like Plain, Linear, and Mintlify.

THIS WON'T BE THE RIGHT ROLE IF YOU...

- Want a clear process for every situation before you act.

- Would rather code all day than talk to customers.

- See AI tools as something you’ll get around to eventually.

- Want the structure and pace of a large company.

WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

You will often speak with developers who need assistance understanding if their applications work well and if not, what caused the issue. This requires a solid technical background and a genuine motivation to help and learn.

- Empathy: You love working with customers and solving their problems. Checkly is critical to them, and we genuinely want to unblock them.

- Some experience in a technical role, for example, as a developer or in technical support.

- You can read and debug JavaScript, TypeScript and Node.js code.

- You’re comfortable with HTTP, REST APIs, browser dev too

This role engages directly with providers to identify barriers, refine workflows, enhance EHR tools, and support adoption of efficient documentation practices. title: UX & Performance Designer
description:
Releaf is the UK's leading medical cannabis clinic. With over 170 staff, we connect patients with specialist clinicians, streamline access to prescriptions, and support thousands of people across the UK. We're on a mission to rethink healthcare - making specialist medical care more accessible, more human, and more effective.
The role
You'll report into our Head of Performance Marketing and sit within the performance team, working closely with our Paid Search and Paid Social Specialists. This is a hands-on design role split across two areas:
UX for paid media landing pages. You'll have full accountability for the design of our paid media landing pages: the experience someone has the moment they click an ad. User flows, wireframes, final designs, testing and iteration are all yours, and so is making them convert.
Design for paid channels. You'll create the static and video creative that runs across our paid media, predominantly Meta ads, with other channels likely to follow as we grow.
Owning both ends of the journey means you control the message from first impression to conversion. The best person for this job understands that a great ad isn't just one that looks good. It stops the scroll, earns the click, and lands on a page that converts. You'll be doing it in a category where advertising is tightly regulated, so accuracy and compliance matter as much as performance.
Main responsibilities
Paid media landing pages

• Own the UX and design of our paid media landing pages end to end, from user flows, wireframes and prototypes through to final designs and QA on the live page

• Design mobile-first, fast, accessible pages with a clear path from first click through to booking a consultation

• Plan and run a continuous landing page testing roadmap with the performance team: layouts, messaging, forms, page structure and offers

• Use GA4, heatmaps and session recordings to understand how people actually use our pages and where they drop off, and turn that into the next iteration

• Build and maintain a landing page design system and component library, so new pages and variants can go live quickly

• Work with our developers and partners to get pages built accurately, and own the quality of what goes live

Paid channel creative

• Produce static and video creative for Meta, built to perform and iterate on quickly: hooks, formats, angles, static vs video

• Work closely with our Paid Social Specialist on the creative testing roadmap, turning briefs and performance data into the next round of creative

• Edit and produce short-form video, from UGC assembly through to fully motion-designed pieces, with sound and subtitling for social

• Adapt and extend creative for other paid channels as we grow, such as display, YouTube, TikTok or digital out-of-home

Across both

• Make sure the message matches from ad to landing page, so the journey feels like one joined-up experience

• Work within the advertising regulations specific to our sector, making sure every ad and page is compliant before it goes live, and working with our compliance team on reviews and amends

• Build and maintain templates and brand assets so the team can move faster

• Keep output consistent with brand guidelines while adapting to the demands of each channel

• Stay current on platform formats, UX best practice and what's actually working

What we're looking for
Essential

• At least 3 years' professional design experience (ideally 5), covering both UX or web design and paid or performance creative

• A portfolio that shows both: landing pages or web journeys you've owned (with results if you have them), and paid social creative that ran

• Solid UX fundamentals: user flows, wireframing, prototyping, information hierarchy, and mobile-first, accessible design

• Hands-on experience testing and optimising landing pages and ad creative, and an instinct for performance: you understand why a hook or a page works, not just how to execute one

• Strong static and motion craft

title: Veiligheidskundige / HSE Specialist (f/m/x)

The role: What's in the Box

You’ll join our HSE (Health, Safety & Environment) team in Bleiswijk as an HSE Specialist ( Veiligheidskundige ), helping bring the HSE strategy to life at our Distribution Center and logistics hubs. You’ll be the go-to person for all health, safety and arbo matters on site. Think forklift traffic, manual handling, ergonomics and chilled storage areas, with a large and diverse team working across multiple shifts. Making safety stick here is as much about people and behavior as it is about procedures.

Most of your time will be spent on the floor, spotting risks before they become incidents and working with teams to solve them. Your biggest impact will be on our safety culture: helping people understand not just what needs to be done, but why it matters, so that safety becomes something everyone owns.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Conduct risk assessments, workplace inspections and incident investigations, and follow up on actions with operational teams to keep improving safety performance.

• Lead root cause analysis on incidents and near misses, and turn your findings into clear, practical procedures.

• Design and deliver trainings, toolbox talks and awareness sessions that build safety ownership across all teams and shifts.

• Support managers and team leads in applying HSE policies and staying compliant with Dutch health and safety legislation.

• Run internal audits and compliance checks, and share findings and progress with the HSE team and site leadership.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to design practical, sustainable solutions for risks and unsafe situations.

• Be visible on the work floor: listen, observe and empower employees to speak up and take safety into their own hands.

Additional details

• Work location: Bleiswijk (on-site presence required), with occasional visits to our logistics hubs

• Work-from-home flexibility: 1 day per week

• Working hours: Monday to Friday, during office hours

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• A bachelor’s degree with an MVK or HVK qualification, or a background in integral safety (IVK).

• Experience in a Health & Safety role, ideally in logistics, production or manufacturing.

• Solid knowledge of Dutch health and safety legislation and risk assessment methods, plus hands-on experience with incident investigation, root cause analysis and internal audits.

• Strong communication and influencing skills: you motivate rather than enforce, and you know how to bring people along.

• A hands-on, organized approach: you go to the floor, co-create solutions, and keep priorities clear in a fast-paced, changing environment.

• Full professional proficiency in English. Ideally, you also speak Dutch at a professional or native level.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

title: Staff Technical Marketing Manager (Staff TMM) – Browser Security & Secure Access

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed - we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:
At CrowdStrike, we are redefining security for the modern era. As a Staff Technical Marketing Manager for Falcon Secure Access, you will help shape how customers secure work in the browser, protect access across managed and unmanaged devices, reduce legacy access complexity, govern AI usage, and stop adversaries before browser-based threats become breaches. You will also influence the product marketing strategies that drive adoption, competitive wins, and CrowdStrike’s mission to stop breaches.
The Staff Technical Marketing Manager (Staff TMM) for Browser Security and Secure Access (Falcon Secure Access) combines advanced technical expertise with product marketing leadership to shape how CrowdStrike positions, markets, and delivers modern browser-native security, secure enterprise access, and Zero Trust access solutions, including CrowdStrike Falcon Secure Access.
This role is ideal for a hands-on technical marketing expert with a strong background in network security, secure remote access, VPN, ZTNA, SASE/SSE, enterprise browser security, or identity-aware access who can translate complex technical capabilities into compelling demos, technical narratives, and go-to-market content.
Reporting to the Sr. Director of Technical Marketing, you will serve as an individual contributor within the Product Marketing team. You will play a critical role in defining messaging, creating compelling technical stories, and driving go-to-market success for Falcon Secure Access. Your work will directly influence product positioning, customer adoption, competitive win rates, and CrowdStrike’s leadership in modern secure access, Zero Trust browser security, remote connectivity, safe browsing, BYOD and contractor access, and AI security.

• Rédaction de la documentation technique : élaborer les dossiers d’architecture, les spécifications techniques générales et détaillées, les procédures d’installation et d’exploitation ainsi que les comptes rendus d’intervention.

• Migration et mise en production : préparer et réaliser les opérations de migration, effectuer les tests de bon fonctionnement, valider la conformité des configurations et accompagner la mise en service des solutions.

• Support technique et résolution d’incidents complexes : apporter une expertise technique lors des phases d’intégration, analyser les dysfonctionnements rencontrés chez les clients et proposer des solutions correctives adaptées.

• Transfert de compétences : accompagner les équipes techniques et les clients dans la prise en main des solutions déployées, en partageant les bonnes pratiques d’utilisation, d’administration et d’exploitation.

• Veille technologique et amélioration continue : suivre les évolutions des technologies de sécurité, évaluer les nouvelles solutions du marché et contribuer à l’amélioration des méthodes, des architectures et des pratiques d’intégration.

Votre profil
De formation Bac+4/5, vous justifiez d’au moins 4 ans d’expérience en cybersécurité, idéalement chez un intégrateur.
Vous disposez de solides compétences techniques sur les solutions de sécurité réseau :

• Fortinet,

• Check Point,

• Palo Alto,

• Juniper)

• du loadbalancing (F5), de proxy (BlueCoat, IronPort),

• de sécurité des endpoints (SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, Trend Micro, McAfee, Symantec) et de sécurité Cloud (CASB).

Passionné(e) par les nouvelles technologies, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre expertise technique, votre excellent relationnel et vos capacités rédactionnelles.
Vous savez évoluer dans des environnements multi-projets et multi-clients, tout en faisant preuve d’autonomie, de rigueur et d’un bon esprit d’équipe.
Entité
Orange Cyberdefense est l’entité stratégique du Groupe Orange dédiée à la sécurité numérique. Nous accompagnons les entreprises de toutes tailles, organismes critiques, administrations et collectivités locales dans la conception de leurs stratégies de cybersécurité, leur mise en œuvre et leur gestion opérationnelle.
Nous leur apportons notre expertise afin d’assurer le meilleur niveau de protection de leurs données, de leurs équipements et des services qu’ils offrent à leurs clients ou leurs administrés.
Avec un CA de 1,3 Md€ en 2025, 7% de croissance et plus de 3.300 experts dédiés à la cybersécurité, nous nous positionnons aujourd'hui comme le Leader européen sur le marché de la cyberdéfense.
Notre vocation est de construire une société numérique plus sûre.

title: Work with Ukraine
description:
Твоя кар’єра з Київстар. Приєднуйся до команди!
Не знайшли вакансію, яка відгукується саме вам? Або ще шукаєте напрям, у якому хочете розвиватися? Не обов’язково чекати на ідеальну вакансію, щоб зробити перший крок назустріч новим можливостям!
Залишайте своє резюме в Київстар - давайте знайомитися!
Київстар - це більше, ніж телеком. Це команда людей, які створюють технології, розвивають цифрові продукти, реалізують масштабні проєкти та щодня роблять внесок у майбутнє України.
Ми шукаємо таланти з різним досвідом, навичками та амбіціями. Незалежно від того, чи ви вже досвідчений фахівець, чи тільки розпочинаєте свій кар’єрний шлях, - у Київстар можуть знайтися можливості саме для вас.
Чому Київстар?
Безбар’єрне середовище. Поважаємо індивідуальність кожного та створюємо простір, де комфортно бути собою.
Гнучкість у роботі. Гнучкий графік та гібридний формат роботи залежно від посади.
Турбота про добробут. Страхування здоров’я та життя, соціальні гарантії й додаткова підтримка у важливих життєвих ситуаціях.
Розвиток без обмежень. Навчання, менторство, внутрішні кар’єрні можливості та інструменти для професійного зростання.
Підтримка, коли це потрібно. Програми ментальної та емоційної підтримки для співробітників і їхніх родин.
Комфортний старт. Продумана адаптація та колеги, які підтримують із першого дня.
Підтримка захисників і захисниць. Програма «4.5.0. Нарешті вдома» для військових, ветеранів та їхніх родин.
Робота зі змістом. Ми підтримуємо країну, суспільство й армію та створюємо проєкти, що мають значення для мільйонів українців.
Як це працює?
Залишайте своє резюме.
Наша команда рекрутингу ознайомиться з вашим досвідом та професійними інтересами.
Якщо з’явиться можливість, яка відповідає вашому профілю, ми зв’яжемося з вами, щоб обговорити наступні кроки.
Можливо, саме зараз починається ваша наступна кар’єрна історія. І ми будемо раді, якщо вона буде з Київстар!

Ми прагнемо бути чесними та відкритими, діяти етично, правдиво і сумлінно. Ми розуміємо важливість захисту ваших Персональних даних та прагнемо використовувати провідний досвід у цьому напрямі. title: Enterprise Account Executive - Southern Europe
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters - keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

YOUR TASKS

- Build and execute plans for named enterprise accounts, prioritising the organisations and use cases with the strongest potential.

- Generate pipeline through thoughtful, account-based outreach and create access to stakeholders across multiple business units.

- Lead consultative discovery to understand customer priorities, identify cross-functional projects and establish where Statista can deliver measurable value.

- Strong discovery skills and the ability to build evidence-based commercial cases.

- Experience navigating procurement, approvals and negotiations through to signature.

- Fluent English and business-level proficiency in French, Italian or Spanish. Additional southern european languages are an advantage.

- Able to work from our London office, opposite Southwark Station, two days a week, and travel for customer meetings and industry events.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

- Hybrid work and flex-time

- Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

- Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

title: AFFILIATE PARTNERSHIPS MANAGER
description:
AFFILIATE PARTNERSHIPS MANAGER
We Realize Potential in Your Story

We are a multi-platform production company, social media agency, and digital media network who are currently on a quest to find a Affiliate Partnerships Manager to join our Network team - Is this your next opportunity?
We're looking for an individual to help power one of the largest deal-focused channels on YouTube (3M subscribers). The Affiliate Partnerships Manager will own, scale, and optimize the affiliate commerce revenue engine for one of our lead Creator channels. In this role, you will lead publisher-side affiliate strategy and day-to-day commercial relationship management, partnering directly with top-tier US retail merchants and affiliate networks. Working closely with the Content and Channel Management teams, you will be tasked with maximizing earnings via affiliate links/shopping features. You will be responsible for proactively negotiating bespoke commission increases, securing exclusive promotional codes and advance deal sheets for marquee shopping events (such as Prime Day and Black Friday/Cyber Monday), and aligning high-converting retail deals with our content calendar. You will collaborate closely with the Channel Manager and the content production team to integrate affiliate links seamlessly into video descriptions, community posts, and newsletters while maintaining audience trust and strict compliance.
HOW YOU WILL SPEND YOUR TIME
Retailer partnership management and business development

• Manage and scale direct relationships with major US retail partners, (eg. Amazon and Walmart) alongside major affiliate networks (eg. Impact, CJ Affiliate, MagicLinks).

• Pitch and negotiate with retailers and networks to secure beneficial commission rates, hybrid campaign fees, performance bonuses, exclusive merchant coupon codes, and curated landing pages to drive maximum revenue yield.

• Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for brand affiliate managers, affiliate PR reps, and network account teams.

Affiliate strategy and operations

• Own and execute the commercial affiliate playbook for the Creator channel, including around major retail tentpole events such as Amazon Prime Day, Fall Prime Day, Black Friday, Cyber Monday, and Q4 holiday shopping.

• Regularly liaise with merchant partner contacts (including well in advance of tentpole dates) to secure embargoed deal sheets, early bird promotions, high-tier commission incentives, and guaranteed exclusive promotional codes.

• Coordinate with content and channel production leads to plan timely content releases that capitalize on real-time flash sales and lightning deals.

Product curation and link operations

• Curate commercially compelling, high-converting product selections tailored to the audience's interests, seasonal trends, and upcoming video releases.

• Coordinate with the Channel Management team to supply optimized affiliate tracking links, promotional copy, and call-to-action (CTA) text for video descriptions, pinned comments, newsletters, and social channels.

• Manage smart-link routing and redirection platforms (e.g., Geniuslink) to ensure multi-retailer fallback logic, global geo-targeting, and rapid resolution of out-of-stock items or broken URLs.

Performance analytics and compliance

• Maintain tracking structures to attribute revenue, clicks, and conversion by video, placement type, product category, and distribution channel.

• Monitor and report on core performance indicators and run regular A/B testing on channel output to improve performance

• Ensure that 100% of affiliate placements and promotional messaging strictly adhere to FTC disclosure regulations, merchant operating terms, and host platform community policies.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED
Skills matter, experience is useful, attitude is everything.

• Proficiency across major affiliate networks including Amazon Associates, Impact, CJ Affiliate, Rakuten, ShareASale, PartnerStack, Commission Juncture and MagicLink

title: AI Security Researcher
description: About the Role As an AI Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in AI/ML security, software development in Python, backed by a minimum MSc in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related discipline. You have hands-on experience with AI workloads, large language models, training frameworks, advanced optimization algorithms, GPU clusters, and ideally SLURM in HPC environments. You excel at modeling AI threats-model/data poisoning, permission escalation, backdoors, data drift attacks, prompt injection-and translating them into practical security defenses. You will be one of Haste's first AI security researchers pioneering defenses for trillion-parameter AI training environments alongside HPC and quantum workloads. Key Responsibilities Adversarial Threat Research: Investigating emerging attack vectors and developing techniques to uncover vulnerabilities in AI models, data pipelines, and infrastructure. Threat Modeling & Risk Analysis: Mapping and characterizing potential threats across the AI lifecycle-from data ingestion to deployment-to prioritize security investments. Developing Defenses & Guardrails: Designing and implementing detection logic and researching mitigation methods to AI threats. Collaborating with Engineering Teams: Translating research findings into actionable, production-grade security requirements for product teams, ensuring threat detection makes sense. Documentation & Reporting: Creating technical reports, whitepapers, and proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits to document vulnerabilities and share findings within the organization or to the public. Monitoring AI Ecosystem Trends: Staying updated on the latest AI security standards, frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS), and academic research. Requirements University degree

title: Head of Growth (Paid Media + Client Accounts + AI) | Marketing for Multi-Locatio
locationText: Anguilla, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina +45 more
description:
Company Overview
Our client is a marketing team that works inside businesses with many locations, such as senior living communities, med spas, dental and healthcare groups, cannabis retailers, and schools. Its clients are in the US and Canada, and they pay a flat fee instead of a percentage of ad spend.
The company runs on Claude and has built its own operating system and client portal. AI agents do most of the production, so a small team can run a lot of client work.
Your Role
As Head of Growth, you're the final decision-maker on 6 to 10 client accounts, across paid media, websites, CRM, and creative. Agents and teammates bring you options, and you pick one, approve it, or send it back with the exact fix.
You report to the CEO and work as a peer to the founders. You'll start by taking over the approval queue on every active account. By day 90, delivery runs without the CEO in the loop, and you've built the tool or process that lets the team take on 5 more accounts with the same people.
Part of the job is building. You'll release features to the internal platform by directing Claude Code: you write the spec, test it on staging, and merge it. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to know exactly what you want and check that you got it.
This isn't an account manager role. If you've mostly passed the calls on spend, creative, or pricing to someone else, or you'd rather delegate to a team of specialists, it probably isn't the right fit.
You'll

• Run the client relationship with owners, executive directors, and sales teams

• Approve Google Ads and Meta builds before launch

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
Principal AI Engineer (AI / .NET Core / React)
At Mitratech , we’re a team of engineers passionate about building world-class products that empower Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR professionals at Fortune 100 companies. We thrive in a global, inclusive culture that values innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence.
With continued growth, we’re looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join our HotDocs Team . HotDocs is Mitratech ’s flagship document automation platform, used by enterprise clients worldwide to streamline the assembly of complex legal documents and contracts.
You'll set the technical direction for AI at HotDocs - designing and delivering new AI-powered enterprise capabilities and driving our adoption of AI across the software development lifecycle. This is a remote-first role.
About the Role
As a Principal AI Engineer, you will:

•
Set the AI Technical Direction: Own the architecture for AI capabilities across HotDocs - model management, LLM and agent orchestration, retrieval strategy, evaluation, cost and latency management - and translate it into a pragmatic delivery roadmap.

•
Deliver Enterprise AI Features: Take new AI-powered features from prototype to production at enterprise scale, writing clean, maintainable code in .NET Core and React and holding the bar for performance, security, and readability.

•
Drive AI Adoption in the SDLC: Lead how we use AI across engineering - coding assistants, agentic workflows, test generation, code review, and documentation - selecting tooling, defining safe and effective usage patterns, and measuring the impact on delivery.

•
Build Trustworthy AI: Establish evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and AI governance practices so that AI features are accurate, explainable, and safe for use in regulated, compliance-heavy environments.

•
Bring Deep Technical Expertise: Apply strong .NET and React ecosystem knowledge to complex problems, modernize and refactor legacy code where it blocks AI integration, and improve system scalability and reliability.

•
Lead and Mentor: Raise the AI capability of the wider engineering group through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, brown-bag sessions, and clear written guidance.

•
Influence Across the Business: Partner with product management, architecture, security, and customer-facing teams to shape the AI roadmap, evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, and set realistic expectations for what AI can deliver.

•
Enhance DevOps and AI Ops: Extend CI/CD pipelines to cover AI workloads - prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation gates, monitoring, and cost tracking - working closely with DevOps engineers.

•
Focus on the User: Ensure AI features solve real customer problems and deliver a great experience through attention to detail, responsiveness, transparency, and accessibility.

About You
You are:

•
A Technical Leader: You set direction without needing authority, build consensus across teams, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical peers.

•
An AI Practitioner, not a Spectator: You have shipped AI features to real users, keep pace with a fast-moving field, and can tell genuine capability from hype.

•
Evidence-Led: You care about maintainable code, testing, and measurable outcomes - you evaluate AI systems with data rather than intuition.

•
Adaptable and Pragmatic: You balance long-term architectural goals with the practical needs of a sprint-driven environment, and you know when a simple solution beats a model.

•
Security-, Privacy- and Performance-Minded : You build with scalability and resilience in mind, using secure-by-design principles, and you treat data privacy and responsible AI as first-order concerns.

Required Skills and Experience

• 12 or more years of professional software development experience, including time in a principal, lead, or staff-level technical role.

• Strong skills in .NET Core (C#) and React (TypeScript) or similar SPA frameworks - this remains a hands-on engineer

title: AI Engineer | NLP & Large Language Models Specialist
description:
Ως μέλος της AI ομάδας της DOTSOFT, ο AI Engineer (NLP/LLM) θα αναλάβει ρόλο-κλειδί στην ανάπτυξη καινοτόμων εφαρμογών βασισμένων σε LLMs, συμπεριλαμβανομένων:

• Εξατομικευμένων ψηφιακών βοηθών (AI Assistants)

• Συστήματων αυτόματης παραγωγής και ανάλυσης κειμένου

• Chatbots και conversational agents σε πολυγλωσσικό περιβάλλον

• Εργαλείων κατανόησης περιεχομένου και semantic search

Η θέση απαιτεί τεχνολογική ευελιξία, βαθιά γνώση των σύγχρονων AI εργαλείων και ικανότητα συνεργασίας σε διεπιστημονικά έργα.
Κύριες Αρμοδιότητες

• Σχεδιασμός και ανάπτυξη λύσεων NLP με χρήση Large Language Models (π.χ. OpenAI, HuggingFace Transformers, LLaMA, Mistral κ.ά.).

• Fine-tuning και βελτιστοποίηση προεκπαιδευμένων μοντέλων σε εξειδικευμένα datasets.

• Ανάπτυξη pipelines για data preprocessing, training, evaluation και deployment σε cloud/edge περιβάλλοντα.

• Συμμετοχή σε έργα R&D που ενσωματώνουν AI σε επιχειρησιακές και ερευνητικές πλατφόρμες.

• Συνεργασία με Software Engineers, UI/UX Designers και Systems Architects για την ολοκληρωμένη υλοποίηση λύσεων.

• Συμβολή στη συγγραφή τεχνικών παραδοτέων και τεκμηρίωσης AI modules.

• Παρακολούθηση εξελίξεων στον χώρο του NLP & LLMs και εισαγωγή νέων μεθοδολογιών.

Απαραίτητα Προσόντα

• Πτυχίο ΑΕΙ σε Πληροφορική, Ηλεκτρολόγων Μηχανικών ή συναφές πεδίο Πληροφορικής / τεχνολογίας Υπολογιστών.

• Απαραίτητο Μεταπτυχιακό σε Τεχνητή Νοημοσύνη.

• Επαγγελματική ή ερευνητική εμπειρία σε έργα NLP και Machine Learning .

• Άριστη γνώση Python και ML libraries (π.χ. TensorFlow , PyTorch , HuggingFace Transformers ).

• Εμπειρία σε fine-tuning και ανάπτυξη εφαρμογών βασισμένων σε LLMs .

• Κατανόηση αρχών Deep Learning, language embeddings, semantic search και conversational AI.

• Εμπειρία σε χρήση APIs μεγάλων μοντέλων (π.χ. OpenAI API) και ανάπτυξη custom λύσεων.

• Εξοικείωση με cloud περιβάλλοντα (AWS, Azure, GCP) ή on-premise AI deployment.

• Ικανότητα συγγραφής τεχνικής τεκμηρίωσης στα Αγγλικά.

Επιθυμητά Προσόντα

• Εμπειρία σε multilingual NLP projects ή επεξεργασία ελληνικής γλώσσας.

• Καλή γνώση MLOps πρακτικών (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines).

• Εμπειρία σε AI Ethics, Explainability (XAI) και Responsible AI.

• Συμμετοχή σε ερευνητικά έργα ή ανάπτυξη prototypes στο πλαίσιο R&D.

• Κατανόηση αρχιτεκτονικών Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) .

• Εμπειρία σε vector databases (π.χ. FAISS , Pinecone )

Τι Προσφέρουμε

• Συμμετοχή σε πρωτοποριακά έργα με έμφαση στην Τεχνητή Νοημοσύνη και το NLP.

• Συνεχής επαγγελματική ανάπτυξη μέσω ενασχόλησης με σύγχρονες AI τεχνολογίες.

• Συνεργασία με διεπιστημονικές ομάδες σε διεθνές περιβάλλον.

• Δυνατότητα συμβολής στη διαμόρφωση καινοτόμων λύσεων που αξιοποιούν τις τελευταίες εξελίξεις στον χώρο των LLMs.

Εκδήλωση Ενδιαφέροντος
Εάν σας ενδιαφέρει να συμμετάσχετε σε μια δυναμική ομάδα που αξιοποιεί την Τεχνητή Νοημοσύνη για την ανάπτυξη προηγμένων λύσεων, παρακαλούμε αποστείλετε το βιογραφικό σας.
Η DOTSOFT ενθαρρύνει υποψηφίους με ισχυρό τεχνικό υπόβαθρο και πάθος για την εξέλιξη στον χώρο του AI, ακόμη και αν δεν πληρούν το σύνολο των επιθυμητών προσόντων.
Η DOTSOFT Α.Ε. , πρωτοπόρος στον τομέα της Πληροφορικής και Επικοινωνιών (ICT), επενδύει συστηματικά στην αξιοποίηση προηγμένων τεχνολογιών Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης για την ανάπτυξη καινοτόμων ψηφιακών λύσεων. Στο πλαίσιο των έργων Έρευνας & Ανάπτυξης (R&D) και των διεθνών συνεργασιών της, η DOTSOFT αναζητά εξειδικευμένο AI Engineer με εστίαση σε Natural Language Processing (NLP) και Large Language Models (LLMs) .
Ο κατάλληλος υποψήφιος θα συμβάλλει ενεργά στον σχεδιασμό, ανάπτυξη και ενσωμάτωση λύσεων Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης σε σύνθετες πλατφόρμες και έργα, με έμφαση στη γλωσσική κατανόηση, επεξεργασία φυσικής γλώσσας και conversational AI εφαρμογές.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. - Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

- Partner with the marketing team to develop content that will resonate with lawyers, tailored to the unique needs of their practice areas and client types.

- Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

- Tailor the introduction of new solutions to specific customer needs.

- Further the market perception of Harvey as uniquely credible, substantive, and helpful in applying its AI solutions to make lawyers better at their jobs.

- Conduct research and analysis on customers and competitors.

title: Program Manager, NPI
description:
Willow is a platform for products that help improve the lives and health of women. We are a mission-driven team of experienced inventors, mothers, and fathers dedicated to making a difference in women’s lives. The Willow™ Wearable Breast Pump, selected as one of TIME's 25 Best Inventions in 2017 and 2018 CES Innovation Award for Wearable Technologies, is the first solution in our platform.

Job Overview:
Willow is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead new product introduction (NPI) for our connected medical devices. This role requires close collaboration with hardware, firmware, software, regulatory/quality, clinical, and manufacturing teams to bring safe, reliable, and connected products to market. The Program Manager will drive requirements gathering, design controls, and technical feasibility, and will execute cross-functional plans to hit key program milestones from concept through launch and sustaining.
What you'll do:

• Manage complex cross-functional NPI programs for connected medical devices, from concept through design, verification and validation, transfer to manufacturing, and sustaining.

• Collaborate with hardware, firmware, mobile/app, regulatory, quality, and clinical teams to define requirements, set priorities, and establish scope, budget, and timelines.

• Drive program-level risk management (per ISO 14971) by identifying, assessing, and mitigating technical, regulatory, and schedule risks throughout the product lifecycle.

• Own and maintain program schedules, design history file (DHF) milestones, and phase-gate deliverables in partnership with quality and regulatory affairs.

• Be a force-multiplier for functional leads to resolve issues, proactively removing obstacles and facilitating cross-team decision making.

• Coordinate device connectivity workstreams (e.g., Bluetooth/BLE, companion app, cloud/data integration) with software and security teams to ensure a cohesive user experience.

• Develop recommendations, gain stakeholder alignment, and communicate program status and risks clearly to leadership.

• Support design transfer and manufacturing readiness activities in collaboration with operations and contract manufacturers.

What you'll bring:

• 12+ years of experience, with 5+ years of program or project management in medical devices or another regulated hardware/software industry.

• Bachelor's degree or higher preferred, or equivalent experience.

• Experience leading NPI programs for connected or electro-mechanical medical devices through the full lifecycle, from concept to launch and sustaining.

• Working knowledge of FDA QSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and ISO 14971, and experience partnering with regulatory/quality teams to meet design control requirements.

• Experience coordinating hardware, firmware, and connected software/app workstreams within a single program.

• Experience using Atlassian tools such as JIRA & Confluence for project management, analysis, and reporting.

• An ability to communicate technical problems and solutions clearly to diverse audiences at all levels of the organization.

• A strong sense of ownership, urgency, and drive.

• An agile project management style, approach, and execution.

• Strong familiarity with project management software tools (e.g. SmartSheet, JIRA/Atlassian), methodologies, and best practices.

• Project Management Professional (PMP) or Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification preferred.

Willow is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status.
